Sky Manipulation — Cursed Technique Reversal

With great mastery over the Reverse Cursed Technique, you have found the reversal of your technique. Instead of being able to bend and shape the sky, you remove it entirely, making it seem as if it never existed in the first place and pulling in outside space to cover it up. As an action for 6 cursed energy, you choose a point within 60 feet of you. All creatures in a 20 foot radius of said point must make a Strength saving throw, as you delete the space surrounding the area. On a failure, a creature is pulled to the point and takes bludgeoning damage depending on the size and quantity of creatures it hits. On a success, a creature is still pushed however they take half as much damage. If they fail by 5 or more, they are also stunned until the beginning of your next turn. A creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to twice your CE modifier per creature hit. However, for every size the creature is above tiny, your CE modifier is added once again. Creatures smaller than medium or with a Strength score lower than your cursed energy DC make the saving throw with disadvantage.
